items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: on opening night I did 'High Button Shoes' with Phil Silvers

ctx.x: Right. Well, maybe some of them had a bad night. Each night would be different. I was always asked about playing a show for a length of time. It changes with the performance. You know, things happen on stage, in the orchestra pit, and they're all things that keep you alert, you know, and you may be reading your book in the pit and you

hear a miscue on the stage, you're alerted to to that. And you have to adjust to the conductor and -- (Laughter.) -- on opening night I did 'High Button Shoes' with Phil Silvers, and this is my first big show. Number one, the light went out. So that held up the show. And we'd rehearsed --
You mean the light over your music stand.
